title: ddd's modified Darceno's Minecarts
description: Fork of Darceno's Minecarts with some minor changes, as well as new additions
body:
**This is a modified fork of the original datapack [Darceno's Minecart's](https://modrinth.com/datapack/darcenos-minecarts), which is licensed under MIT.**

There are a couple things that I wanted to remove and add. Idealistically, the changes are minimal, and the principle of faster minecart speeds are the same. Here is a list of changes from the original datapack:

- Added condition that tracks must be on gravel in order to have faster minecart effect (based on [track ballasting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Track_ballast) in real life).
- Removed chunk loading capabilities (due to possible [/forceload chunk leak](https://github.com/darceno/darcenosminecarts/issues/26))
- Removed modified powered rail recipe, reverting back to the vanilla recipe.
